name: Camino 'Bliss' Watermelon Lemonade High Dose Gummies [10pk] (200mg THC)
description: Camino Watermelon Lemonade Bliss Gummies are a burst of summer joy in every bite. Designed to lift your mood and add a little sunshine to your day, these gummies combine sweet watermelon and tart lemonade flavors with a carefully balanced dose of THC and blissful terpenes. The result? A delicious and light-hearted edible that feels just as good as it tastes.
